description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy values for three sentiment annotation approaches across two tweet-related categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” presented left to right, and the x-axis label reads “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For “Emoji Tweets,” there are three adjacent bars: a light gray TEXTBLOB bar at approximately 0.33, a darker gray hatched VADER bar at approximately 0.45, and a solid green ChatGPT bar at approximately 0.67. For “Overall Tweet,” the same three bars appear in the same left-to-right order within the group: TEXTBLOB at approximately 0.40, VADER at approximately 0.47, and ChatGPT at approximately 0.66. The bars are grouped side-by-side (not stacked), with a legend inside the plotting area identifying TEXTBLOB (light gray), VADER (hatched gray), and ChatGPT (green); the categories are not shown as sorted by value, and no individual bars appear specially annotated beyond the color/hatching and the legend.
